Requirements:
- Previous Mayor's Permit
- Declaration of Gross Sales
- Barangay Clearance
Process:
- Submit documentary requirements to BPLS.
- Get assessed and secure Order of Payment.
- Pay at the CTO.
- Claim renewed Business Permit.
Fee: Based on gross sales declaration and local tax code.

Requirements:
- Structural plans
- Property documents
- Fire Safety Clearance
- Locational Clearance
Process:
- Submit plans to Office of the Building Official (OBO).
- Pay filing fee.
- OBO evaluates plans.
- Pay final fees.
- Receive Building Permit.
Fee: Filing fee + Final building permit fees.
Location: Office of the Building Official (OBO) and CTO
